- x0 = fgpartition(I) — objects of non-background colors

- x2 = color(x1) — its color
- x3 = leftmost(x1) — column index of the cell
- x4 = width(I) — 10
- x5 = interval(x3, x4, TWO) — from x3 to 9 step 2
- x6 = apply(tojvec, x5) — vectors (0, j)
- x7 = mapply(vfrontier, x6) — vertical frontiers: full columns at those j
- x8 = fill(I, x2, x7) — fill those columns entirely with color x2
- x9 = increment(x3) = x3+1
- x10 = width(I)
- x11 = interval(x9, x10, FOUR) — from x3+1 to 9 step 4
- x12 = add(x3, THREE) = x3+3
- x13 = width(I)
- x14 = interval(x12, x13, FOUR) — from x3+3 to 9 step 4
- x15 = apply(tojvec, x11) — vectors (0, j) for j in x11
- x16 = height(I)
- x17 = decrement(x16) = 9 (bottom row)
- x18 = lbind(astuple, x17) — function j -> (9, j)
- x19 = apply(x18, x14) — cells (9, j) for j in x14
- x20 = combine(x15, x19) — bottom cells for x11 plus (9,j) for x14
- x21 = fill(x8, FIVE, x20)
